rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Pharaoh is the pursuing lower self, his troops the bodily temperaments; the heart, aided by sacred power, parts the material sea, saves Moses through detachment, and drowns the lower self with its forces after removing them from psychic pleasures and appetites.
rows.anchor: فرعون النفس في التلوينات حاشرا جنوده من مدائن طبائع الأعضاء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Anyone devoted to a beloved desire serves it, becomes veiled from God and arrested short of perfection, and thereby opposes the people of divine oneness; otherness exists only in imagination.
rows.anchor: كل من عكف على شيء يهواه ويحبه ويتولاه فهو عابد له

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Satan prompts this worship, while injustice and aggression dominate its worshipper.
rows.anchor: فالباعث على عبادته الشيطان والغالب على عابده الظلم والعدوان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Apart from the Real, nothing independently harms, benefits, sees, or hears: the Real watches every soul, and all acts issue from the presence of His Names.
rows.anchor: ولا يضر غير الحق في شهوده ولا ينفع ولا يبصر بنفسه ولا يسمع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The cited verses affirm that God alone creates, guides, feeds, gives drink, causes illness and healing, and gives death and life.
rows.anchor: فهو الخالق والهادي والمطعم والساقي والممرض والشافي والمميت والمحيي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The idols worshipped apart from God cannot help their worshippers or even defend themselves.
rows.anchor: أين ما كنتم تعبدون من دون الله هل ينصرونكم أو ينتصرون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The ultimate outcome is that worshippers find no intercessors and no intimate friend.
rows.anchor: فما لنا من شافعين ولا صديق حميم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: At the station of annihilation, sin can arise only from a remaining trace of self; the speaker fears this remnant and hopes for its forgiveness through the light of the Essence.
rows.anchor: ولما كان هذا المقام مقام الفناء وذنبه لا يكون إلا بوجود البقية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He hopes that on the Great Resurrection God will not deprive him for the reappearance of that remnant.
rows.anchor: ولا يجازيني من ظهور البقية بالحرمان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Solomon's book signifies practical wisdom and divine law.
rows.anchor: أي: الحكمة العملية والشريعة الإلهية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Solomon's instruction to withdraw and observe asks whether the recipients will accept obedience and submission or refuse.
rows.anchor: أيقبلون الطاعة والانقياد أم يأبون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Solomon's name points to the Essence that grants preparedness, faculties by which potential is actualized in intellect, and fitting perfection in moral qualities and attributes.
rows.anchor: بإفاضة الاستعداد وما يخرج به ما فيه إلى العقل من الآلات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The command not to exalt themselves means they must neither overpower nor claim superiority over Solomon.
rows.anchor: ألا تغلبوا ولا تستعلوا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The command to come means to arrive obedient and surrendered.
rows.anchor: منقادين مستسلمين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The queen's appeal for counsel signifies the soul's receptive, noble essence resisting its powers' pride and domination, though it can accept only with their support and consultation.
rows.anchor: إشارة إلى قابلية النفس ونجابة جوهرها ومخالفتها لأمر قواها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The threatened ruin of the town and humiliation of its honored people signify restraining pleasures and disciplining the powers that dominate the soul.
rows.anchor: وإفساد القرية وإذلال أعزتها إشارة إلى منعها عن الحظوظ واللذات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Worshipping the Lord of the town means turning away from everything but the Real; the town is the heart, protected from lower-soul qualities and impure entrants so its people are safe from nature's fire.
rows.anchor: أي: القلب { الذي حرمها } حماها عن استيلاء صفات النفس ومنعها من دخول أهل الرجس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Everything belongs to God's sovereignty and lordship; He gives or withholds whatever He wills and repels whoever opposes Him.
rows.anchor: تحت ملكوته وربوبيته يعطي عابده ما شاء أن يعطيه ويمنعه ما شاء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those called Muslims have surrendered their faces through annihilation in God.
rows.anchor: الذين أسلموا وجوههم بالفناء فيه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Reciting the Quran means bringing its gathered perfections into actuality in the station of subsistence.
rows.anchor: أفضل الكمالات المجموعة في إبرازها وإخراجها إلى الفعل في مقام البقاء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Praising God means taking on His praiseworthy attributes.
rows.anchor: بالاتصاف بصفاته الحميدة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One reading of the signs God will show is His attributes disclosed in the station of the heart.
rows.anchor: صفاته في مقام القلب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, the signs are God's acts and effects overpowering the lower soul, which it recognizes through the suffering they cause.
rows.anchor: أو آيات أفعاله وآثارها بالقهر في مقام النفس فتعرفونها عند التعذب بها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A further reading places the signs at the trumpet blast: the Essence discloses itself at the Great Resurrection.
rows.anchor: بتجلي الذات في القيامة الكبرى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: At that blast the heavens and earth panic under the universal blow of annihilation, except those granted abiding life, who revive through God's life and awaken after annihilation.
rows.anchor: بصعقة الفناء والقهر الكلي إلا من شاء الله من أهل البقاء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: All come humbled: they have fallen from the rank of life and existence and are overcome.
rows.anchor: عن درجة الحياة والوجود، مقهورين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Existences seem outwardly fixed like mountains but in reality pass away like clouds.
rows.anchor: تحسبها جامدة ثابتة على حالها ظاهرا وهي تمر مر السحاب في الحقيقة زائلة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The city is the body, entered when its psychic powers are quiet, lest they dominate the heart.
rows.anchor: أي: في حال هدو القوى النفسانية وسكونها حذرا من استيلائها عليه وعلوها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The two combatants are intellect and passion; intellect belongs to Moses' party, while passion follows satanic fancy and the commanding lower self.
rows.anchor: أي: العقل والهوى { هذا } أي: العقل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Intellect seeks the heart's aid against passion, and the heart strikes passion through practical wisdom and angelic support, using its practical rational faculty.
rows.anchor: العقل واستنصره على الهوى { فوكزه } ضربه بهيئة من هيئات الحكمة العملية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Calling the conflict satanic means Satan prompted passion to transgress and aggress.
rows.anchor: الاستيلاء والاقتتال { من عمل الشيطان } الباعث للهوى على التعدي والعدوان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, the killing itself is satanic because excess is treated through the opposite vice of deficiency rather than merciful justice; both extremes are vices.
rows.anchor: لأن علاج الاستيلاء بالإفراط لا يكون بالفضيلة التي هي العدالة الفائضة من الرحمن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Examples of satanic treatment by opposite extremes are checking greed with lethargy, miserliness with extravagance, and wastefulness with stinginess.
rows.anchor: كعلاج الشره بالخمود وعلاج البخل بالتبذير والإسراف بالتقتير كلاهما من الشيطان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses' self-wronging is excess and deficiency; he asks God to veil that vice with the light of justice, and God thereby establishes justice in his soul.
rows.anchor: بالإفراط والتفريط { فاغفر لي } استر لي رذيلة ظلمي بنور عدلك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God is the Veiler who covers the soul's dispositions with His light and the Merciful who grants perfection when the soul is purified of vices.
rows.anchor: الساتر هيئات النفس بنوره { الرحيم } بإفاضة الكمال عند زكاء النفس عن الرذائل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses asks God to preserve him through the gifts of knowledge and action, so that he will not assist psychic powers committing vices.
rows.anchor: أي: اعصمني بما أنعمت علي من العلم والعمل { فلن أكون ظهيرا } معاونا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In the body-city, he fears the psychic powers' domination through impulses, inner thoughts, and whisperings during vigilance.
rows.anchor: من استيلاء القوى النفسانية بإشارة الدواعي والهواجس وإلقاء أحاديث النفس والوساوس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The intellect seeks aid against fancy and imagination, which corrupt vigilance, stir doubts and impulses, and never relent while the heart exists except at annihilation in God.
rows.anchor: وهي الوهم والتخيل لأنهما يفسدان في مقام الترقب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Fancy and imagination oppose the heart by accusing it of wanting tyranny rather than reform.
rows.anchor: إن تريد إلا أن تكون جبارا في الأرض وما تريد أن تكون من المصلحين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The heart calls its companion deviant because intellect is captivated by fancy, unable to repel it, and needs the heart's help.
rows.anchor: بقوله: إنك لغوي، لافتتانه بالوهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The heart could not complete its intended attack because fancy obstructed and condemned it, asking whether it would repeat yesterday's killing.
rows.anchor: وإنما أراد أن يبطش ولما تيسر له البطش، ومانعه وأنكر فعله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Fancy remains permitted until the Great Resurrection; while the heart is only at the youthful station of its intermediate resurrection, fancy hopes to mislead it.
rows.anchor: لم يذعن له شيطان الوهم لأنه من المنظرين إلى يوم القيامة الكبرى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Mere intellectual and practical perfection cannot restrain fancy's ascendancy before the heart reaches the spirit and annihilation in sainthood with divine attributes.
rows.anchor: فما دام القلب في مقام الفتوة متصفا بكمالاته في القيامة الوسطى يطمع هو في إغوائه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Repentance sheds lower-soul qualities that covered inner sight, while faith in the unseen proceeds through knowledge and righteous action beautifies the soul by acquiring virtues.
rows.anchor: تنصل عما غطى بصيرته وغشى قلبه واستعداده من صفات النفس، وآمن بالغيب بطريق العلم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The successful detach from the soul's station through the heart and return to primordial nature beyond the veil of created existence.
rows.anchor: الفائزين بالتجرد عن مقام النفس بمقام القلب والرجوع إلى الفطرة من حجاب النشأة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God creates both veiled people and those granted unveiling, then chooses for them as His will and care determine; they have no independent choice alongside His.
rows.anchor: بمقتضى مشيئته وعنايته لهم ما يريد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God is exalted above any creature having a choice that could rival His.
rows.anchor: نزهه عن أن يكون لغيره اختيار مع اختياره فيكون شريكه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: There is no god but God and no partner with Him in existence.
rows.anchor: لا شريك له في الوجود

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: All absolute praise belongs to God: every manifest and hidden perfection in the forms of the cosmos belongs to Him, so worldly beauty, wealth, strength, and honor are His manifestations.
rows.anchor: المطلق لثبوت جميع الكمالات الظاهرة على مظاهر الأكوان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Likewise, every complete knower and gnostic in the afterlife manifests His perfection, knowledge, and recognition.
rows.anchor: وكل كامل عالم عارف به في الآخرة بكماله وعلمه ومعرفته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's judgment compels all things to His will: worldly ugliness, poverty, weakness, and lowliness fall under His rule and subjugation.
rows.anchor: يقهر كل شيء على مقتضى مشيئته ويحكم عليه بموجب إرادته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In the afterlife, all who remain veiled are forsaken, captive, and rejected under His judgment.
rows.anchor: وكل محجوب مخذول، أسير، مردود في الآخرة في قهره وتحت حكمه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Returning to God means annihilation in His existence, acts, attributes, or Essence.
rows.anchor: بالفناء في وجوده أو أفعاله وصفاته أو ذاته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Remembrance unfolds through the stations: spoken remembrance in the soul, presence in the heart, intimate conversation in the secret, witnessing in the spirit, union in the hidden, and annihilation in the Essence.
rows.anchor: باللسان في مقام النفس، والحضور في مقام القلب، والمناجاة في مقام السر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Glorifying God entails transcending acts, attributes, and Essence.
rows.anchor: بالتجريد عن الأفعال والصفات والذات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Morning begins with the heart's light and the lower self's darkness receding; the spirit's sun sets in annihilation of Essence, so remembrance continues from then to everlasting annihilation.
rows.anchor: وقت طلوع فجر نور القلب وإدبار ظلمة النفس وليل غروب شمس الروح بالفناء في الذات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's blessing comes in response to their glorification through disclosures of acts and attributes; the Essence is too overwhelming for them to endure.
rows.anchor: بتجليات الأفعال والصفات دون الذات لاحتراقهم هناك بالسبحات

rows.speaker: جبريل عليه السلام
rows.claim: Gabriel says that if he advanced by a fingertip's length, he would be burned.
rows.anchor: كما قال جبريل عليه السلام: " لو دنوت أنملة لاحترقت "

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God brings believers from darkness to light through angelic aid and disclosure of the Names: from acts of the lower self to divine acts, from its qualities to divine qualities, and from selfhood to the Essence.
rows.anchor: بالإمداد الملكوتي والتجلي الأسمائي من ظلمة أفعال النفوس إلى نور تجليات أفعاله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God is merciful to believers by granting perfections suited to their state and preparedness.
rows.anchor: يرحمهم بما يستدعيه حاله ويقتضيه استعدادهم من الكمالات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Warning benefits only one who follows the Reminder, because pure, luminous preparedness lets the person respond and accept guidance through innate monotheism and original knowledge.
rows.anchor: لنورية استعداده وصفائه فيتأثر به ويقبل الهداية بما في استعداده من التوحيد الفطري

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Such a person remembers and fears the Merciful by conceiving His majesty while veiled from disclosure, then follows the path to become present to what had been absent and see by its light.
rows.anchor: بتصور عظمته مع غيبته من التجلي فيتبعه بالسلوك ليحضر ما هو غائب عنه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Forgiveness is a vast veiling of sins that veil God's acts, attributes, and Essence.
rows.anchor: عظيمة من ستر ذنوب حجب أفعاله وصفاته وذاته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The noble reward consists of gardens of the Real's acts, attributes, and Essence.
rows.anchor: من جنات أفعال الحق وصفاته وذاته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Praising God means acquiring His perfections and reaching the bliss of disclosures of His attributes.
rows.anchor: بالاتصاف بكمالاته والوصول إلى نعيم تجليات صفاته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God fulfilled the promise deposited in them at the primordial covenant and communicated through His messengers.
rows.anchor: بإيصالنا إلى ما وعدنا في العهد الأول وأودع فينا وأنبأنا عنه على ألسنة رسله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The inheritance is the garden of divine attributes, where each dwells according to rank and spiritual condition.
rows.anchor: جنة الصفات { نتبوأ } منها { حيث نشاء } بحسب شرفنا ومقتضى حالنا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The best reward belongs to those who act on what they know and inherit the garden of heart and soul, with their lights and effects.
rows.anchor: الذين عملوا بما علموا فأورثوا جنة القلب والنفس من الأنوار والآثار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The angels are the powers of the spirit in the garden of attributes, surrounding the heart's throne; detached from material attachments, they praise God through spiritual perfections.
rows.anchor: ملائكة القوى الروحانية في جنة الصفات { حافين من حول } عرش القلب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Judgment in truth means they agree and unite in pursuing perfection through justice and divine oneness, each assigned its proper glorification without dispute.
rows.anchor: بتسالمهم واتحادهم في التوجه نحو الكمال بنور العدل والتوحيد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Praise spoken in the station of unity belongs absolutely to the divine Essence with all its attributes, the Lord who nurtures each according to its readiness and condition.
rows.anchor: على لسان الأحدية { الحمد } المطلق في الحضرة الواحدية للذات الإلهية الموصوفة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, the angels are souls and celestial spirits around the greatest sphere's throne in the Garden of Eden, praising God through their immaterial perfections.
rows.anchor: أو ملائكة النفوس والأرواح السماوية حافين في جنة الفردوس من حول عرش الفلك الأعظم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In that alternative, just judgment assigns each the acts and perfections decreed for it, while all proclaim that absolute perfection belongs to God, Lord of the worlds.
rows.anchor: باختصاص كل بما حكم به الحق من الأفعال والكمالات. وقيل على لسان الكل: الكمال المطلق لله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If the resurrection is the lesser one, the body's earth is grasped and immobilized at death, the spiritual faculties are folded, and the final breath's trumpet blast fells psychic and spiritual powers except the deathless spiritual reality and human subtlety.
rows.anchor: وأرض البدن جميعا قبضته، يتصرف فيها بقدرته ويقبضها عن الحركة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: At the second breath, a new birth comes through life and balance; the book is the soul's tablet of deeds, which appear before prophets and witnesses who know people's preparedness and states, and judgment is just.
rows.anchor: ثم نفخ فيه أخرى في النشأة الثانية بنور الحياة والاعتدال ووضع الكتاب، أي: لوح النفس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who dispute God's signs are veiled from the Real; the un-veiled accept the signs through their preparedness without denying His attributes.
rows.anchor: المحجوبون عن الحق لأن غير المحجوب يقبلها بنور استعداده من غير إنكار لصفاته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The veiled dispute falsely to invalidate the signs because their dark essence and corrupt interior cannot receive them, making punishment deserved.
rows.anchor: يجادل فيها { بالباطل } ليدحض بجداله آياته فيحق له العقاب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The throne-bearers are either rational celestial souls whose influence reaches lower worlds while they transcend and govern the heavens, or the spirits those souls love.
rows.anchor: من النفوس الناطقة السماوية اللاتي أرجلهم في الأرضين السفلى بتأثيرهم فيها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those around the throne are the holy, disembodied spirits and planetary souls.
rows.anchor: من الأرواح المجردة القدسية والنفوس الكوكبية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their glorification consists in transcending material attachments through their immaterial being and praising God by manifesting the perfections received from Him.
rows.anchor: ينزهونه عن اللواحق المادية بتجرد ذواتهم حامدين له بإظهار كمالاتهم المستفادة منه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: By their state they say, 'O One whose attributes and gifts are such.'
rows.anchor: فكأنهم يقولون بلسان الحال: يا من هذه صفاته وهباته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their faith in God is direct, real vision.
rows.anchor: الإيمان العياني الحقيقي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They seek forgiveness for believers through luminous aid and effusions because their essences share the reality of faith.
rows.anchor: بالأمداد النورية والإفاضات السبوحية لمناسبة ذواتهم ذواتهم في الحقيقة الإيمانية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's mercy encompasses everything and His knowledge encompasses all.
rows.anchor: شملت رحمتك وأحاط بالكل علمك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They ask God to forgive those who repent by His light, shedding dark dispositions and material darkness, and who follow His path through the beloved's example in deeds, stations, and states, relinquishing the sins of acts, attributes, and essence.
rows.anchor: إليك بالتجرد عن الهيئات الظلمانية والظلمات الهيولانية { واتبعوا سبيلك } بالسلوك فيك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They ask God to protect these believers from the hell of nature through His care.
rows.anchor: بعنايتك { عذاب } جحيم الطبيعة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: On the day of appearing, people emerge from veils of selfhood or bodily coverings.
rows.anchor: عن حجاب الأنيات أو غواشي الأبدان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Nothing is hidden from God: concealed deeds become visible in their records and move from latency into appearance, as the cited verses say; alternatively, people emerge from veils of attributes into the Essence itself.
rows.anchor: لظهورها في صحائفهم وبروزها من الكمون إلى الظهور

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When all are annihilated in the unity of the gathering, God asks who holds sovereignty; only He answers, the One beyond all else, the Subduer who annihilated all by His force.
rows.anchor: ينادي به الحق سبحانه عند فناء الكل في عين الجمع فيجيب هو وحده

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The reckoning is swift because it occurs all at once: recorded sins bring their consequences and good deeds their fruits.
rows.anchor: لوقوعه دفعة باقتضاء سيئاتهم المكتوبة في صحائف نفوسهم تبعاتها وحسناتها ثمراتها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The approaching event is the near lesser Resurrection.
rows.anchor: أي: الواقعة القريبة وهي القيامة الصغرى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hearts reach throats from the intensity of fear.
rows.anchor: لدى الحناجر } لشدة الخوف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who say God is their Lord affirm His oneness by denying all else and recognizing Him with certain, true knowledge.
rows.anchor: وحدوه بنفي غيره وعرفوه بالإيقان حق معرفته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their uprightness is wayfaring toward God and steadfastness on His path, acting sincerely for Him without turning elsewhere.
rows.anchor: إليه بالسلوك في طريقه والثابت على صراطه مخلصين لأعمالهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Angels descend because believers share true oneness, certain faith, steady deeds, and an upright path; by contrast, dark essences and evil deeds make veiled souls akin to devils, so devils descend to them.
rows.anchor: للمناسبة الحقيقية بينهم في التوحيد الحقيقي والإيمان اليقيني والعمل الثابت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They need not fear punishment because their essences are illuminated and stripped of dark dispositions.
rows.anchor: من العقاب لتنور ذواتكم بالأنوار وتجردها عن غواسق الهيئات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They need not grieve over perfections missed, since those perfections were determined by their preparedness.
rows.anchor: بفوات كمالاتكم التي اقتضاها استعدادكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They are promised the garden of divine attributes.
rows.anchor: بجنة الصفات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, they first profess God in annihilation and remain upright through God in subsistence after annihilation; angels descend to honor them as they return to differentiation, since no angels or others exist in annihilation.
rows.anchor: بالفناء فيه ثم استقاموا به بالبقاء بعد الفناء عند التمكين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In that reading, the angels tell them not to fear spiritual variegation or grieve over immersion in oneness; those returning from unity initially grieve the loss of direct witnessing and their veiling by multiplicity.
rows.anchor: من التلوين { ولا تحزنوا } على الاستغراق في التوحيد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Once established in subsistence, multiplicity no longer veils unity and unity no longer veils multiplicity: they witness the Essence in the detail of attributes; the cited verses describe the expansion of the Prophet's breast and removal of his burden.
rows.anchor: ولا الوحدة عن الكثرة، شاهدين في تفاصيل الصفات عين الذات بالذات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: For the alternate reading, the promised garden is the all-encompassing garden of the Essence, which contains every garden of attributes.
rows.anchor: بجنة الذات الشاملة لجميع مراتب الجنان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Every nation is motionless and powerless because it is inherently dead and incapable, as the cited verse says; alternatively, nations kneel at the first assembly before recompense, in the condition of their first creation, a matter containing a secret.
rows.anchor: لا حراك بها إذ هي بنفسها ميتة غير قادرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Each nation is summoned to its book, the tablet on which its deeds were inscribed and their images embodied; there are four tablets, with the lower tablet given to each nation and handed by right to the fortunate and left to the wretched.
rows.anchor: اللوح الذي أثبت فيه أعمالها وتجسدت صورها وانتقشت فيه على هيئة جسدانية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The three other tablets are celestial and higher; the present book is the lower tablet because this passage concerns recompense for deeds and the recording of what people did.
rows.anchor: والثلاثة الأخرى سماوية علوية أشير إليها فيما قبل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The scribes who copy people's deeds are the heavenly and earthly angelic realm together.
rows.anchor: والناسخون هم الملكوت السماوية والأرضية جميعا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Believers may have imitative faith in the unseen or certain, learned faith; they perform good works that prepare them for bodily return, and God admits them to the reward of works in the garden of acts.
rows.anchor: الإيمان الغيبي التقليدي أو اليقيني العلمي { وعملوا } ما صلح به حالهم في المعاد الجسماني

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Disbelievers are veiled from the Real by original disbelief and immersion in dark corporeal dispositions.
rows.anchor: احتجبوا عن الحق بالكفر الأصلي والانغماس في الهيئات الجرمانية المظلمة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's saying that He forgets them means either leaving them in torment as they abandoned the work of meeting Him through denial, or forsaking them like something forgotten because they forgot the primordial covenant.
rows.anchor: نترككم في العذاب كما تركتم العمل للقائي في يومكم هذا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: All praise belongs to God because all things attain their ends and the highest perfection possible to them.
rows.anchor: الكمال المطلق الحاصل للكل ببلوغ الأشياء إلى غاياتها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God is Lord of the heavens as the one who perfects and governs spirits.
rows.anchor: مكمل الأرواح ومدبرها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God is Lord of the earth as the one who governs, owns, and directs bodies.
rows.anchor: مدبر الأجساد ومالكها ومصرفها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God directs both worlds to their perfections through His sustaining lordship.
rows.anchor: موجه العالمين إلى كمالاتهم بربوبيته إياهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: His grandeur is absolute exaltation and loftiness: He needs nothing, while everything needs Him; creatures praise by manifesting their perfections and magnify Him through their change, contingency, dependence, and inherent limits.
rows.anchor: باستغنائه عنه وافتقاره إليه، فكل يحمده بإظهار كماله وجميع صفاته بلسان حاله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Mighty is powerful and subdues everything, compelling it through His effect upon it.
rows.anchor: القوي القاهر لكل شيء بتأثيره فيه وإجباره على ما هو عليه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Wise arranges every thing's preparedness by subtle governance and prepares it to receive His intended attributes through exact craft and hidden wisdom.
rows.anchor: المرتب لاستعداد كل شيء بلطف تدبيره، المهيىء لقبوله لما أراد منه من صفاته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Truly affirming God requires detaching from all ties and obstacles, turning wholly to Him, and guarding sight from transgression; remaining traces or fear of spiritual change would make the profession insincere.
rows.anchor: تجردوا عن العلائق ورفضوا العوائق وانقطعوا إلى الله عن كل ما سواه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Uprightness means realizing God in action and keeping the etiquette of His presence so completely that every pulse and hair moves only by and for Him.
rows.anchor: بالتحقق به في العمل والتحفظ به في مراعاة آداب الحضرة عن الزلل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They have no fear because there is no veil or punishment.
rows.anchor: إذ لا حجاب ولا عقاب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They have no grief because nothing desired is absent or can be lost; God consoles for every calamity and replaces all that is lost.
rows.anchor: إذ لا مرغوب إلا وهو حاصل لهم فلم يفت منهم شيء ولا يفوت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They possess the unrestricted paradise that encompasses every garden, remaining there as recompense for their work during the wayfaring that led to arrival.
rows.anchor: المطلقة الشاملة للجنان كلها { خالدين فيها جزاء بما كانوا يعملون } في حال السلوك حتى الوصول

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The soul initially serves the body and does not gain clear insight or discernment until sexual maturity, as illustrated by the rule that an orphan's property is released when sound judgment appears.
rows.anchor: كما قال في اليتامى: حتى إذا بلغوا النكاح فإن آنستم منهم رشدا فادفعوا إليهم أموالهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: This is outward maturity: from childhood, nature uses food beyond bodily replacement to grow the weak body, keeping the soul submerged in the body and occupied with nature until that age.
rows.anchor: لضعف الأعضاء وشدة الاحتياج إلى النمو والتصلب، فالنفس حينئذ منغمسة في البدن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: As bodily faculties near completion and growth demands lessen, nature turns toward preserving the species; the soul is freed to pursue perfection, its intellect opens, innate light appears, and it recognizes its sacred essence and goal.
rows.anchor: تفرغت النفس إلى تحصيل كمالها، فانفتحت بصيرة عقلها وظهرت أنوار فطرتها واستعدادها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The soul can seek its goal because its faculties are usable for perfection and the body's demands occupy it less.
rows.anchor: لأمرين: صلاحية الآلات للاستعمال في الاستكمال وفراغها عن تخصيص البدن بالإقبال لقلة الإشغال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: While bodily growth and strengthening remain possible, the soul cannot turn wholly to the higher realm; this continues until about thirty, as medicine explains, after which it turns to its own realm and seeks perfection more intensely.
rows.anchor: وذلك إلى منتهى الثلثين من السن كما تبين في علم الطب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: At about forty, the Holy Spirit, guardian of the true orphans, recognizes the soul's readiness and gives it the wealth of realities, gnosis, knowledge, and wisdom; it can then wed holy separated beings and journey through God's attributes to Essence in complete annihilation.
rows.anchor: أن آنس رشدها في دفع أموالها التي هي الحقائق والمعارف والعلوم والحكم إليها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A saying holds that a Sufi who has not begun purification, seeking, and wayfaring through divine acts before forty is not found mature by the Holy Spirit and does not receive the spiritual treasures.
rows.anchor: الصوفي بعد الأربعين أبذ، إذ لم يستعد بالتوجه والطلب والسير في الأفعال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Once the soul completes its wayfaring in God through annihilation at this maturity, it enters subsistence after annihilation and upright action.
rows.anchor: كان وقت البقاء بعد الفناء وأوان الاستقامة في العمل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Because abiding blessings must be secured with gratitude, he asks for gratitude for the perfection attained after uncountable prior gifts, preserving it from obscuration, weariness, disobedience, and self-reliance.
rows.anchor: ولما كانت النعم أوابد يجب تقييدها بالشكر استوزع الشكر على نعمة الكمال

rows.speaker: عليه السلام
rows.claim: The Prophet asks, 'Should I not be a grateful servant?'
rows.anchor: قال عليه السلام: " أفلا أكون عبدا شكورا "

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He asks God to preserve the blessing of guidance and perfection through obedient acts that express gratitude for gifts given to him and his parents, the proximate cause of his existence.
rows.anchor: فطلب محافظة نعمة الهداية والكمال عليه بإيقافه على الطاعات التي هي شكر نعمته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Kindness and prayer for parents are due because his perfection reflects their good, character, and sound inner quality; he is their secret.
rows.anchor: إذ لو لم يكن فيهما خير وخلق حسن وسر صالح لم يظهر عليه ذلك الكمال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Every prophet was sent only after forty except Jesus and John, who nevertheless stopped in some of the heavens.
rows.anchor: ولهذا لم يبعث نبي قط إلا بعد الأربعين سوى عيسى ويحيى ومع ذلك وقفا في بعض السموات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Righteous work means perfecting those prepared for it; the perfected person's first duty is preserving his own perfection, then completing those ready to receive it.
rows.anchor: بتكميل المستعدين فإن الواجب على الكامل أولا محافظة كماله ثم تكميل المستكملين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Good deeds are relative: an act may be good for one person and bad for another, as the saying 'the good deeds of the righteous are misdeeds of those brought near' illustrates.
rows.anchor: فربما كان صالحا بالنسبة إلى أحد سيئا بالنسبة إلى غيره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: His true children, biological or not, are those he nurtures through knowledge and spiritual training; this succeeds only if they already have readiness and righteous states, which come solely through God's grace.
rows.anchor: أي: أولادي الحقيقية سواء كانوا صلبية أو لا لأن علمه الصالح الذي هو التكميل وتربية المريدين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Without divinely granted readiness and full receptivity, spiritual reform, completion, and guidance have no effect, as the cited verse says God cannot guide whom one loves.
rows.anchor: ولو لم يكن هذا الصلاح والقبول التام الذي لا يكون إلا من عند الله
